about.title: About Me
paragraphs: Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer with 2+ years in mission-critical Data Center and NOC operations. Experienced in maintaining high-availability platforms, monitoring complex infrastructure, and executing fast incident response under SLA constraints.
Focused on automation-first operations: transforming telemetry into actionable dashboards, improving MTTR, and driving operational reliability across production environments.

achievements: Handled 24/7 mission-critical infrastructure operations across production environments.
Maintained service performance aligned with 99.99% availability and strict SLA requirements.
Reduced incident resolution time (MTTR) by 30-40% through proactive monitoring and triage flow improvements.
Automated operational reporting workflows, cutting manual reporting effort by 50-60%.
Monitored multi-system infrastructure (Network, BMS, EMS, CCTV, Access Control) in 24/7 operations.
Executed first-response incident triage with escalation discipline to minimize service impact.
Analyzed recurring faults and collaborated in root-cause elimination initiatives.
Improved operational visibility using structured dashboards and recurring KPI reports.

projects.title: Live ETL Weather Operations Dashboard
projects.tech: JavaScript • Open-Meteo API • ETL • Data Visualization
projects.description: Built a browser-based ETL pipeline that extracts live weather telemetry, transforms it into operational KPIs, and loads dashboard cards, trend chart, and a snapshot table for stakeholders.
projects.problem: Operational telemetry was scattered and difficult for stakeholders to interpret quickly.
projects.solution: Built a browser ETL flow to extract Open-Meteo data, transform 24-hour KPIs, and load visual components in real time.
projects.result: Enabled a clear decision-ready dashboard demo with live API integration for portfolio and interview discussions.

projects.title: Operational Incident & NOC Analytics Dashboard
projects.tech: Power BI • Excel • Python • Real-time Data
projects.description: Developed Power BI dashboards for NOC and Data Center Command Center operations. Enabled management reviews and operational decision-making with real-time incident analysis by date, category, and priority.
projects.problem: Managers lacked a unified incident view across time, severity, and category.
projects.solution: Designed Power BI views and summary slices for daily monitoring and weekly operational reviews.
projects.result: Improved reporting clarity and reduced preparation time for management reviews.

projects.title: Infrastructure Monitoring Automation
projects.description: Implemented comprehensive monitoring infrastructure for 24/7 operations. Automated incident detection, escalation workflows, and operational reporting using enterprise monitoring tools.
projects.problem: Monitoring and escalation steps were manual and inconsistent across shifts.
projects.solution: Integrated tool-based alerting and standardized escalation/reporting workflows.
projects.result: Lowered manual effort while improving response consistency and service continuity.

projects.title: Incident Response & SOP Operations
projects.description: Designed and implemented incident response procedures with cross-team coordination. Developed structured escalation processes, SOP-based operations, and proactive monitoring systems.
projects.problem: Incident actions were inconsistent across teams during high-pressure events.
projects.solution: Defined SOP-driven incident paths and handoff checkpoints for each escalation stage.
projects.result: Faster coordination and fewer repeated incidents through structured response practices.
